description: Heavy-lift helicopter in the walled outdoor yard; marked 086. The museum notes that several of its aircraft wear US Air Force markings although they were South Vietnamese Air Force machines, repainted for display.

Ex-VNAF fighter in the outdoor yard, photographed in January 2025 wearing 69170. The museum repaints some airframes in US markings, so the visible number is recorded as an alias rather than an identity.
USAF serial 70-1285 (c/n 43300), transferred to the South Vietnamese Air Force as 287 and taken over by the VPAF as 09. Outdoor yard.
US Navy BuNo 139674, transferred to the South Vietnamese Air Force. Displayed in the outdoor yard wearing 39674.
USAF serial 71-1448 (c/n 185-01989), transferred to South Vietnam as 1448. Outdoor yard.
Reported as US Army UH-1H 69-15753 (c/n 12041); the attribution is given as probable by the source that recorded it, so it should be treated as unconfirmed.
